body.statement: In a quadratic-mean differentiable semiparametric model, at any fixed law where a scalar parameter is pathwise differentiable, the asymptotic variance of every regular estimator of that parameter is no smaller than the squared Hilbert-space norm of its canonical gradient.

source.locator: Sections 2--3, definition, interpretation, and calculation of semiparametric efficiency bounds
source.verbatim_statement: the limiting distribution of any regular estimator is equal to that of a N(0, V) random variable plus noise.

attestation.note: Primary Newey (1990) paper, Semiparametric Efficiency Bounds, DOI 10.1002/jae.3950050202, Section 2 convolution result and Section 3 canonical-gradient calculation; author-hosted course copy at https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~jordan/courses/210B-spring06/readings/newey.pdf.
